youtube_title: My Bunny Is Too Camera Shy For The Holiday Card | Funny Cartoon
description:
Renee needs one holiday card photo before the print shop closes. Her bunny Mochi says he is camera shy. Uncle Marv, twenty two years of mall photos, has a plan. Then another plan. Then three more.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #bunny
tiktok_caption: my bunny says he's camera shy 🐰📸 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #bunny

lines.text: Okay, Mochi. Holiday card photo. The print shop closes at nine. Look at the camera.
No thank you. I am camera shy.
You are a bunny. You do not have a schedule.
I have a very full schedule. Most of it is hiding.
It is one photo. You sit by the tree. You look cute. Done.
I do not look at things. Things look at me. That is the problem.
Okay. Phone up. Three. Two.
I am facing the wall now. The wall has never hurt me.
That is the back of your head. Two hundred people are getting this card.
Then two hundred people can see my good side. It is the back.
Fine. I called in a professional.
Uncle Marv is here! Twenty two years of mall photos. Babies, dogs, one very angry goat.
Was the goat camera shy?
The goat ate the camera. We got a lovely picture of the inside.
Marv, he will not turn around.
Leave it to me. I brought the squeaky toy.
Who is a good bunny? Look at Uncle Marv! Squeak, squeak!
I am looking at the carpet. The carpet does not squeak at me.
Okay. Plan two. The whistle.
Hey! Over here, buddy! Big smile!
A whistle. Wonderful. Now the neighbors think we have a referee.
Mochi, please. Grandma asks for this card every single year.
Grandma still has last year's card. It is on her fridge. I am wearing an elf hat.
You looked adorable.
I looked like a cupcake that lost a bet.
Plan three. Bribery. What does the talent want?
The talent wants one carrot. A whole one. With the leaves.
Fine. One carrot. Then one photo.
Thank you. Delicious. I am still shy.
You just ate the payment.
I ate it shyly.
Plan four. We hide the camera. Inside the holiday sweater.
That is my sweater.
It is a disguise now. Nobody suspects a sweater.
The lens is in the reindeer nose. I see you, sweater.
He found the reindeer. Nobody ever finds the reindeer.
Mochi. Buddy. What will it take?
Privacy. Dignity. A second carrot.
Plan five. I lie on the floor. I become the floor.
Uncle Marv is on the floor now. This is somehow worse.
My back is making a sound. Take the picture while I can still leave.
Everybody freeze. Got it! I got it!
Wait. Why is it my face?
Let me see. That is your face. Very close. Kind of up the nose.
The phone was on the selfie camera. The whole time.
How many pictures did you take?
Three hundred and twelve. All of me saying come on, buddy.
So the camera was never pointing at me.
No.
Oh. Well. In that case.
Hop to the left. Spin. Little foot thing.
He is dancing. Why is he dancing?
I am not camera shy. I am camera polite. I only dance when nobody is filming.
Marv. Flip the camera. Quietly.
Flipping. Flipping like a pancake. A very quiet pancake.
I hear a pancake.
Keep dancing. Please. For Grandma.
One spin. For Grandma. Then I am retiring.
Got it! Bunny mid spin, ears out, sunglasses crooked!
It is perfect. Grandma is going to cry.
Put the nose one on the back. Grandma should see what I went through.
Happy holidays from Renee, Mochi, and Renee's nostrils.
Finally. A card I can be proud of.
